summary: 11 blocking issues, 13 warnings, 1 info. Reality review passed (all 12 claims verified). Architecture, Quality, and Systems reviewers found significant gaps.

blocking_issues.issue: BFG Repo Cleaner history rewrite has no rollback strategy — no pre-rewrite backup branch, no team communication plan, no CI cache invalidation steps documented.
blocking_issues.resolution: Create pre-bfg-backup branch; communicate force-push 24h in advance; store key rotation timeline in secure wiki.

blocking_issues.issue: Deleting Firebase Auth accounts and Firestore test house documents from production with no backup strategy. Associated subcollections and relationships could be orphaned.
blocking_issues.resolution: Run firebase auth:export and gcloud firestore export before deletion; store in quarantine bucket with 30-day lifecycle.

blocking_issues.issue: No kill switch or feature flag for the subscription paywall. A gate logic bug would lock out ALL users simultaneously with no fast recovery path.
blocking_issues.resolution: Add global paywall/enabled flag in Firestore; gate all paywall checks on this flag; grant ops team write access for emergency disable in <5 minutes.

blocking_issues.issue: HIPAA surface audit flagged but deferred to post-launch. Operating without BAAs (Firebase, Stripe, Sentry) for PHI could trigger OCR enforcement.
blocking_issues.resolution: Engage HIPAA-specialized attorney before soft launch. Do not launch until written legal opinion is obtained.

blocking_issues.issue: FCM token refresh cycle is untested and likely unimplemented. Tokens expire; long-lived sessions will silently stop receiving notifications after ~90 days.
blocking_issues.resolution: Implement and test FCM token refresh: token expiry → request new token → update Firestore user doc → verify listeners receive updated token.

blocking_issues.issue: Detox E2E config does not pass IS_E2E_TEST=1 launch arg. firebase-emulator.ts gates on this flag — without it, all E2E tests run against production Firebase.
blocking_issues.resolution: Add IS_E2E_TEST=1 to Detox launch args in .detoxrc.js before running any E2E tests.

blocking_issues.issue: Stripe's `unpaid` subscription status is not handled in the plan. It is a valid Stripe state (distinct from past_due and canceled) and not in the status enum.
blocking_issues.resolution: Add unpaid to all status switch statements in subscription.ts, useSubscriptionGate, and webhook handlers. Treat as subscription_required.

blocking_issues.issue: Webhook → House doc update has no cross-repo E2E test. The seam between regroup-functions and rats-v2 is invisible to unit tests in either repo.
blocking_issues.resolution: Write an integration test that fires a simulated Stripe webhook against the emulator and asserts house.subscriptionStatus is updated in Firestore.

blocking_issues.issue: createOperatorSubscription Cloud Function sets status: 'active' immediately without waiting for Stripe webhook confirmation. If Stripe creates the subscription as trialing, Firestore says active — a contradiction.
blocking_issues.resolution: Do not set status in createOperatorSubscription; use intermediate pending status until webhook confirms. UI shows pending state.

blocking_issues.issue: Multi-house batch update in webhook is not atomic. If a write to one house fails mid-batch, some houses get canceled status and others retain active — guests in un-updated houses retain access indefinitely.
blocking_issues.resolution: Wrap multi-house updates in a Firestore transaction. On failure, roll back all writes and enqueue for explicit retry.

blocking_issues.issue: AI rate limiting proposed as client-side (10 calls/house/day). Client-side limits can be bypassed by clearing app data or using multiple accounts, causing unbounded Anthropic API spend.
blocking_issues.resolution: Enforce rate limiting server-side in Cloud Function using houses/{houseId}/aiUsage rolling counter. Return HTTP 429 when exceeded. Client-side limit is cosmetic only.

warnings.issue: Legacy plan_* Stripe IDs referenced in codebase. Switching to new price_* IDs could break subscription lookups for existing test subscribers.
warnings.resolution: Grep for plan_ references; document migration path in webhook logic; test webhook against both formats.

warnings.issue: House.subscriptionStatus defaults to 'active' in the entity — fail-open behavior means unsigned-up houses have full access until webhook fires.
warnings.resolution: Set Firestore default to 'canceled'; add webhook retry logic and dead-letter handling.

warnings.issue: Firestore batch limited to 500 ops. Operators with 500+ houses would hit the limit and silently leave some houses un-updated.
warnings.resolution: Implement pagination in webhook for large batches; add Sentry alert when batch size approaches 450.

warnings.issue: Oxford Firestore rules deployed atomically — a bad rule locks all Oxford operations immediately with no staged rollout.
warnings.resolution: Test rules in staging; deploy with 10% → 50% → 100% staged rollout using house ID hash.

warnings.issue: Subscription paywall test strategy lacks concrete file paths and test names. Plan says 'unit + integration + E2E' without specifying locations.
warnings.resolution: Add explicit test file locations to the subscription paywall spec.

warnings.issue: Cross-repo webhook integration has no test. Webhook (regroup-functions) and house doc update (rats-v2) are verified in isolation but never together.
warnings.resolution: Write cross-repo integration test against Firebase Emulator that fires webhook and asserts Firestore state.

warnings.issue: Sentry observability for gate logic not instrumented. DataContext swallows errors instead of propagating them; no test verifies gate failure paths trigger Sentry.
warnings.resolution: Add logException() to gate failure paths; add test asserting Sentry.captureException is called when Firestore is unavailable during gate check.

warnings.issue: CONTRADICTION: Plan recommends deleting E2E test accounts (Domain 4.2) but also recommends providing test credentials for App Review (Domain 1.1). These conflict.
warnings.resolution: Maintain a dedicated App Review account set separate from E2E test accounts. Document credentials in password manager.

warnings.issue: Edge case: operator with 0 houses can hold a subscription with no billable unit; edge case: guest with no house assigned hits gate with undefined houseId.
warnings.resolution: Add guard in useSubscriptionGate for undefined house; show 'contact support' screen for guest with no house.

warnings.issue: Webhook idempotency not addressed. Duplicate delivery of customer.subscription.deleted overwrites guestGraceEndsAt with a later timestamp, effectively extending the grace period.
warnings.resolution: Store Stripe event.id in Firestore; skip processing if event.id already exists.

warnings.issue: Web→mobile race: manual refresh and webhook can race. If webhook timestamp is older than manual refresh, the older (stale) value wins.
warnings.resolution: Include lastUpdatedAt on all subscription state updates; client only accepts updates with lastUpdatedAt > existing.

warnings.issue: operatorUid lookup (Open Question #1) unresolved. If query returns 0 results, webhook fails silently and house subscription status is never updated.
warnings.resolution: Store userId in Stripe metadata at subscription creation; implement DLQ for failed lookups.

warnings.issue: React Query cache invalidation on AppState fires before currentUser loads on cold start, producing ['house', undefined] — a no-op that leaves stale data.
warnings.resolution: Defer cache invalidation until after useUser() returns loaded state.

info.issue: Guest grace period compared against client clock. Device with wrong clock could lock guests out early or grant extra time.
info.resolution: Move time-based access gates to server-side enforcement (Cloud Function or Firestore Rules). Client shows badge only.

reality_review.notes: All 12 claims verified against codebase. useOxfordGate, offlineQueue, shareReceipt, subscriptionIsActive, House.subscriptionStatus, key factories, Detox device name, and max retry count all match plan descriptions exactly.
